My value is $31. I need to consider how Andy and Charles will bid. A simple strategy would be to bid slightly below my value, say $30. However, if they bid lower, I could win with a lower bid. If they bid close to their values, I might lose. I'll start with a bid of $29.50. This gives me a good chance of winning if their values are lower than mine, and I don't overpay by too much if I win. I will bid $29.50.

This is a single-round auction, so there's no long-term learning to consider. My goal is to maximize my profit in this round. I should bid less than my value to ensure a profit if I win. If I bid too low, I'll likely lose. If I bid too high (close to my value), my profit margin will be small. I'll start with a conservative bid, perhaps around 70% of my value. That would be around $6.30.
